question: At compute matched to GPT-3 Large, what average zero-shot accuracy does the 2-stage H-Net reach compared with the BPE Transformer, and which larger Transformer does it match?
final_text:

Configuration Transformer (#FLOPs matched to GPT‑3 Large) has Average / acc ↑ = 53.3[HNET:T2:r01].
